unauthorized.title: Access denied
unauthorized.description: The Recycle Bin is only available to system administrators.

header.title: Recycle Bin
header.subtitle: Review data deleted from the system, restore it, or remove it permanently.

selectCategoryHint: Select a category from the menu on the left to view items.

hardDelete.title: Permanently delete record
hardDelete.description: “{name}” ({model}) will be permanently removed. This deletes the row from the database and cannot be undone. Do you want to continue?

restoreAll.title: Restore all?
restoreAll.description: All deleted records in “{model}” will be restored.

emptyBin.title: Empty recycle bin?
emptyBin.description: All records in “{model}” will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

forceDelete.title: Force delete with dependencies
forceDelete.description: “{name}” ({model}) cannot be deleted directly. If you confirm, the linked records below will also be permanently removed.
forceDelete.dependenciesTitle: Records that will also be deleted
forceDelete.noDeps: No extra dependencies found; only the selected record will be deleted.
